# Privacy & Data Flow Checklist: Questionnaire Feedback

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature requirements fully specify employee-private questionnaire storage, RLS-as-employee data flow, aggregate-only manager visibility, and forward contracts for feature 017.
**Created**: 2026-06-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are confirmatory outcome requirements complete for all persisted values (`confirmed`, `false_alarm`, `opened_chat`) and their required session/window/time linkage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 Are employee-private storage requirements defined for both confirmatory outcomes and session-end feedback, including explicit exclusion from manager-visible paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-054, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK003 Are weekly work-environment storage requirements complete enough to ensure the stored shape is identity-stripped and aggregate-friendly before feature 017 consumes it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-051, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK004 Are RLS-as-the-employee and no-service-role requirements specified for every questionnaire data path that stores or reads employee-owned data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024d, Spec §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements explicit that session-end free text and the "too robotic" signal never reach Ren, manager-visible aggregates, or manager/admin layers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036, Spec §FR-057]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the `false_alarm` aggregate marker requirement clear about referencing the triggering window/time without mutating the immutable window reading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024a, Spec §FR-024b, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "anonymized team-level aggregate" defined with enough requirement detail to prevent individual attributed weekly answers from being exposed by future manager features? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary between employee-owned private records and future manager aggregate consumption clearly documented for feature 017 planning? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024b, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the requirements clear that employee Today card and own monitoring trend behavior remains unchanged after any confirmatory outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024c, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Are the privacy requirements consistent with Constitution Principle I / Amendment 13 and do they avoid any manager-visible individual answer path? [Consistency, Spec §Constitution Alignment]
- [ ] CHK011 Are window immutability requirements consistent across Functional Requirements, Key Entities, Edge Cases, and Success Criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024a, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-016]
- [ ] CHK012 Are session-end feedback routing requirements consistent across the negative reason flows, Ren exclusion, and manager-layer exclusion? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-032-FR-037, Spec §FR-057]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are privacy success criteria measurable for prohibited flows, including zero manager-attributed weekly answers and zero Ren/manager routing for session-end product feedback? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Are aggregate-contract success criteria measurable for `false_alarm` markers while preserving no-service-role and immutable-window constraints? [Measurability, Spec §SC-016, Spec §SC-017]
